summary:
STELLIX — Junior Astronaut Academy is a web-based learning platform designed to help young people explore what it takes to become an astronaut. We wanted to make space education more interesting and practical, rather than just teaching students facts from books.
Through STELLIX, students can explore space science, learn about astronaut training, understand daily life aboard the International Space Station, and discover how astronauts survive in space and on the Moon. The platform brings together learning courses, quizzes, missions, an AI-powered Space Tutor, and space-related resources in one place.
Our goal is to make astronaut training and space exploration easier to understand and more accessible for young learners. By combining technology with interactive education, STELLIX helps students build curiosity, gain knowledge, and imagine themselves as part of humanity's future in space.
details:
STELLIX — Junior Astronaut Academy is a web-based learning platform designed for students aged 12–18 who are curious about space and astronaut life.

It helps students explore space science, astronaut training, life aboard the International Space Station, and survival on the Moon. The platform includes learning courses, quizzes, interactive missions, a space library, and an AI-powered Space Tutor that helps students understand space-related topics.

Our goal is to make space education more engaging and accessible while inspiring young learners to explore science and future space careers.

We developed STELLIX using Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, PostgreSQL, and Prisma. We also integrated Gemini AI and NASA APIs to support the learning experience.

Our creative approach is to bring astronaut preparation and space education together in one interactive academy. During development, we focused on simple navigation, beginner-friendly content, educational value, and an engaging design.
